Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Servicii IT și consultanță IT
Introduction
 A career in IBM Consulting is built on long-term client relationships and close collaboration worldwide. You’ll work with leading companies across industries, helping them shape their hybrid cloud and AI journeys. With support from our strategic partners, robust IBM technology, and Red Hat, you’ll have the tools to drive meaningful change and accelerate client impact. At IBM Consulting, curiosity fuels success. You’ll be encouraged to challenge the norm, explore new ideas, and create innovative solutions that deliver real results. Our culture of growth and empathy focuses on your long-term career development while valuing your unique skills and experiences.
 Your Role And Responsibilities
 As an Application Developer specializing in SAP ABAP HANA, you will design, develop, and support application solutions with a focus on the HANA version of Advanced Business Application Programming (ABAP). You will work on designing, developing, and re-engineering highly complex application components, integrating software packages, programs, and reusable objects residing on multiple platforms.
 Your Primary Responsibilities Will Include
 Design and Develop Applications: Design, develop, and support application solutions with a focus on HANA version of ABAP, ensuring high-quality and efficient delivery of solutions.
 Integrate Software Packages: Integrate software packages, programs, and reusable objects residing on multiple platforms, leveraging knowledge of SAP HANA Technical Concept and Architecture.
 Re-engineer Application Components: Re-engineer highly complex application components to optimize performance and efficiency, utilizing Data Modelling using HANA Studio and ABAP Development Tools (ADT).
 Ensure Code Performance: Ensure code performance adheres to Code Performance Rules and Guidelines for SAP HANA, utilizing ADBC, Native SQL, and ABAP Core data Services.
 Consume HANA Live Models: Consume HANA Live models, leveraging knowledge of Data Base Procedures, Text Search, ALV on HANA, and HANA Live models consumption.
 Preferred Education
 Master's Degree
 Required Technical And Professional Expertise
 Expert in S/4HANA ABAP architecture and Fiori configuration
 Strong background and experience in SAP S4 ABAP and FIORI development
 Strong experience in complex SAP projects, RAP methodology and clean core approach
 Experience in technical lead/team lead role
 Experience in S4, Fiori, CVA, SAP ADT and BAS
 Experience in creation and working with SAP authorization objects
 Citizenship in European Union country (no dual citizenships)
 Fluent in English
 Strong consulting/facilitation skills
 Fluent in English
 Preferred Technical And Professional Experience
 HANA Live Models Consumption: Experience with HANA Live models consumption, Text Search, and ALV on HANA, with the ability to leverage these technologies to deliver high-quality solutions.
 Data Modelling Expertise: Working knowledge of Data Modelling using HANA Studio, with the ability to apply this expertise to deliver comprehensive solutions.
 Native SQL Proficiency: Experience with Native SQL, with the ability to integrate this technology into application solutions.
